nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a natural number such that $M = 2^p - 1$ is prime, let $L$ be the multiplicative order of $10$ modulo $M$ (the period of the decimal expansion of $1/M$), and suppose that $p$ divides $L$. Then there is a natural number $r$ with $1 \le r \le p - 1$ such that $10^{L/p} \equiv 2^r \pmod{M}$.
